question_english: A farmer has 10 mangoes and sells 4. How many remain?
question_konkani: एक शेतकार 10 आंबे आसता आनी विकता 4. कितले उरतात?
reasoning_english: The farmer starts with 10 mangoes and sells 4. Therefore, 10 - 4 = 6 mangoes remain.
reasoning_konkani: शेतकार १० आंब्यांनी सुरवात करता आनी ४ विकता, देखून १० - ४ = ६ आंबे उरतात.

question_english: A shop has 50 apples. It sells 18 in the morning and 12 in the evening. How many apples remain?
question_konkani: एका दुकानांत 50 सफरचंद आसात. सकाळीं 18 आनी सांजवेळा 12 विकतात. कितले सफरचंद उरल्यात?
reasoning_english: The shop sells a total of 18 + 12 = 30 apples. Therefore, 50 - 30 = 20 apples remain.
reasoning_konkani: दुकानांत वट्ट १८ + १२ = ३० सफरचंद विकतात. देखून ५० - ३० = २० सफरचंद उरतात.

question_english: A school has 3 classes. Each class has 25 students. How many students are there in total?
question_konkani: एके शाळेंत ३ वर्ग आसतात. दर एका वर्गांत 25 विद्यार्थी आसतात. वट्ट कितले विद्यार्थी आसात?
reasoning_english: There are 3 classes with 25 students each. Therefore, 3 * 25 = 75 students in total.
reasoning_konkani: दरेकीं 25 विद्यार्थी आशिल्ले 3 वर्ग आसात. देखून वट्ट ३ * २५ = ७५ विद्यार्थी.

question_english: A baker makes 120 cookies. He packs them into boxes of 10. How many boxes does he need?
question_konkani: एक बेकर 120 कुकीज तयार करता. तो तांकां 10 जाणांच्या पेटींत पॅक करता, ताका कितले पेटी जाय?
reasoning_english: The baker has 120 cookies and packs 10 per box. Therefore, 120 / 10 = 12 boxes are needed.
reasoning_konkani: बेकर कडेन 120 कुकीज आसतात आनी दर पेटींत 10 पॅक करतात. देखून १२० / १० = १२ पेटी जाय पडटात.

question_english: A person has ₹500 and spends ₹175 on food and ₹125 on transport. How much money remains?
question_konkani: एका मनशा कडेन ₹500 आसतात आनी तो ₹175 जेवणाक आनी ₹125 येरादारी खातीर खर्च करता. कितले पयशे उरतात?
reasoning_english: The person spends a total of ₹175 + ₹125 = ₹300. Therefore, ₹500 - ₹300 = ₹200 remains.

question_english: A train travels 60 km in 1 hour. How far will it travel in 3.5 hours at the same speed?
question_konkani: एक रेल्वे 1 वरांत 60 किमी. त्याच वेगान 3.5 वरांत कितले पयस वचतलो?
reasoning_english: The train's speed is 60 km/h. In 3.5 hours, it travels 60 * 3.5 = 210 km.

question_english: If a shirt costs ₹800 and there is a 25% discount, what is the final price?
question_konkani: शर्टाची किंमत ₹800 आनी 25% सवलत आसल्यार निमाणी किंमत कितली?
reasoning_english: A 25% discount on ₹800 is 800 * 0.25 = ₹200. The final price is 800 - 200 = ₹600.

question_english: John reads 15 pages of a book every day. How many pages will he read in 2 weeks?
question_konkani: जॉन दर दिसा पुस्तकाचीं १५ पानां वाचता. 2 सप्तकांत तो कितले पानां वाचतलो?
reasoning_english: There are 14 days in 2 weeks. John reads 15 pages a day, so 15 * 14 = 210 pages.
reasoning_konkani: २ सप्तकांत १४ दीस आसतात. जॉन दिसाक १५ पानां वाचता, देखून १५ * १४ = २१० पानां.

question_english: A recipe requires 3 cups of flour for every 2 cups of sugar. If you use 6 cups of sugar, how many cups of flour do you need?
question_konkani: एके रेसिपींत दर 2 कप साकरे खातीर 3 कप पिठाची गरज आसता. 6 कप साकर वापरल्यार कितले कप पिठ जाय?
reasoning_english: The ratio of flour to sugar is 3:2. Since 6 cups of sugar is 3 times the base amount (2 * 3 = 6), you need 3 * 3 = 9 cups of flour.
reasoning_konkani: पिठाचें साकर हांचें प्रमाण ३:२ आसता. ६ कप साकर मुळाव्या प्रमाणाच्या ३ पटींनी (२ * ३ = ६) आशिल्ल्यान ३ * ३ = ९ कप पिठाची गरज आसता.

question_english: The average age of 4 friends is 20. If three of them are 19, 21, and 22, what is the age of the fourth friend?
question_konkani: 4 इश्टांची सरासरी पिराय 20. तातूंतले तीन इश्ट 19, 21, आनी 22 वर्सां आसल्यार चवथ्या इश्टाची पिराय कितली?
reasoning_english: The total age of all 4 friends is 4 * 20 = 80. The sum of the three friends' ages is 19 + 21 + 22 = 62. The fourth friend is 80 - 62 = 18 years old.
answer_english: The fourth friend is 18 years old.

question_english: A car's fuel tank holds 40 liters. It consumes 8 liters per 100 km. How far can it travel on a full tank?
question_konkani: गाडयेच्या इंधन टांकयेंत 40 लिटर उदक दवरतात. तातूंत दर १०० किमी. पुराय टांकयेचेर कितले पयस वचूंक शकता?
reasoning_english: The car can travel 100 km for every 8 liters. With 40 liters, it can travel (40 / 8) * 100 = 5 * 100 = 500 km.

question_english: A garden is 10 meters long and 5 meters wide. What is its area?
question_konkani: एक बाग १० मीटर लांब आनी ५ मीटर रुंद आसा. ताचो वाठार कितलो?
reasoning_english: The area of a rectangle is length * width. So, 10 * 5 = 50 square meters.
reasoning_konkani: आयताचें क्षेत्रफळ लांबाय * रुंदाय आसता. म्हणजे, १० * ५ = ५० चौखण मिटर.

question_english: Tom earns ₹1500 a day. He works for 5 days and spends ₹2000. How much does he save?
question_konkani: टॉम दिसाक ₹1500 मेळयता. तो 5 दीस काम करता आनी ₹2000 खर्च करता. तो कितलो सांठोवन दवरता?
reasoning_english: Tom earns 1500 * 5 = ₹7500. He spends ₹2000, so he saves 7500 - 2000 = ₹5500.

question_english: A pipe fills a tank in 4 hours. How much of the tank is filled in 1 hour?
question_konkani: एक नळ एक टांकयेक 4 वरां भितर भरता. 1 वरांत टांकयेचो कितलो भाग भरता?
reasoning_english: If the whole tank is filled in 4 hours, then in 1 hour, 1/4 of the tank is filled.
reasoning_konkani: जर पुराय टांक 4 वरांनी भरली जाल्यार मागीर 1 वरांत टांकयेचो 1/4 भाग भरता.

question_english: A book has 300 pages. Mary has read 40% of it. How many pages are left to read?
question_konkani: एका पुस्तकांत ३०० पानां आसतात. तातूंतले ४०% मॅरीन वाचल्यात. कितले पानां वाचपाक उरल्यात?
reasoning_english: Mary has read 300 * 0.40 = 120 pages. The remaining pages are 300 - 120 = 180.
reasoning_konkani: Mary has read 300 * 0.40 = 120 pages. The remaining pages are 300 - 120 = 180.

question_english: If 5 workers can build a wall in 10 days, how many days will 10 workers take?
question_konkani: 10 दिसांनी 5 कामगारांक वण्टी बांदपाक मेळ्ळी जाल्यार 10 कामगारांक कितले दीस लागतले?
reasoning_english: More workers will take less time. The total work is 5 * 10 = 50 worker-days. For 10 workers, it will take 50 / 10 = 5 days.
reasoning_konkani: चड कामगारांक उणो वेळ लागतलो. वट्ट काम ५ * १० = ५० कामगार-दिस. 10 कामगारांक 50 / 10 = 5 दीस लागतले.

question_english: A movie starts at 2:15 PM and lasts for 135 minutes. At what time does it end?
question_konkani: एक सिनेमा दनपारां 2:15 वरांचेर सुरू जाता आनी 135 मिनटां चलता. खंयच्या वेळार तो सोंपता?
reasoning_english: 135 minutes is 2 hours and 15 minutes. Adding this to 2:15 PM gives 4:30 PM.
reasoning_konkani: १३५ मिनटां म्हळ्यार २ वरां आनी १५ मिनटां. हें 2:15 PM कडेन जोडल्यार 4:30 PM मेळटा.

question_english: A store buys a bag for ₹400 and sells it for ₹500. What is the profit percentage?
question_konkani: एक स्टोर ₹400 च्या मोलान एक पोती विकत घेता आनी ₹500 च्या मोलान विकता. फायद्याची टक्केवारी कितली आसता?
reasoning_english: The profit is 500 - 400 = ₹100. The profit percentage is (100 / 400) * 100 = 25%.

question_english: In a box of 50 pens, 4 are defective. How many are good?
question_konkani: ५० पेनांच्या पेटींत ४ दोश आसात. कितले बरे आसात?
reasoning_english: Out of 50 pens, 4 are defective. So, 50 - 4 = 46 pens are good.
reasoning_konkani: 50 पेनांतल्यान 4 पेन दोशी आसात. म्हणजे, ५० - ४ = ४६ पेन बरी आसात.

question_english: A runner completes a 5 km race in 25 minutes. What is his speed in km per hour?
question_konkani: एक धांवपी 5 किमी.ची सर्त 25 मिनटांनी पुराय करता. ताची गती वराक किमी.
reasoning_english: 25 minutes is 25/60 hours. Speed is distance / time = 5 / (25/60) = 12 km/h.

question_english: A bus has 30 passengers. 8 passengers get off and 5 passengers get on. Then 3 more passengers get off. How many passengers remain?
question_konkani: एके बशींत 30 प्रवासी आसतात. 8 प्रवासी देंवतात आनी 5 प्रवासी चडटात. मागीर आनीक 3 प्रवासी देंवतात. कितले प्रवासी उरल्यात?
reasoning_english: Start with 30. Then 30 - 8 + 5 = 27. Then 27 - 3 = 24 passengers remain.
reasoning_konkani: 30 पासून सुरू करात मागीर 30 - 8 + 5 = 27. मागीर 27 - 3 = 24 प्रवासी उरतात.

question_english: A farmer collects 40 eggs. He accidentally drops and breaks 4. He sells half of the remaining eggs. How many eggs does he have left?
question_konkani: एक शेतकार 40 तांतयां एकठांय करता. तो चुकून सोडून मोडटा 4. उरिल्लीं अर्दीं तांतयां तो विकता. ताचे कडेन कितले तांतयां उरल्यात?
reasoning_english: After breaking 4, he has 40 - 4 = 36 eggs. He sells half, so 36 / 2 = 18 eggs remain.
reasoning_konkani: ४ मोडल्या उपरांत ताका ४० - ४ = ३६ तांतयां आसतात. तो अर्द विकता, देखून ३६ / २ = १८ तांतयां उरतात.

question_english: Sarah buys 3 notebooks for ₹40 each and 2 pens for ₹15 each. She pays with a ₹200 note. How much change should she receive?
question_konkani: सारा दरेकीं ₹40 च्या मोलान 3 नोटबुक आनी दरेकीं ₹15 च्या मोलान 2 पेन विकतें घेता. ती ₹200 नोटीन फारीक करता. तिका कितलो बदल मेळपाक जाय?

question_english: A water tank has 500 liters. In the morning, 150 liters are used. In the afternoon, 100 liters are added. In the evening, 200 liters are used. How much water is left?
question_konkani: एक उदकाची टांकय 500 लिटर आसता. सकाळीं १५० लिटर वापरतात. दनपारां 100 लिटर घालतात. सांजवेळार २०० लिटर वापरतात. कितलें उदक उरलां?
reasoning_english: Start with 500. Morning: 500 - 150 = 350. Afternoon: 350 + 100 = 450. Evening: 450 - 200 = 250 liters.

question_english: A warehouse has 1000 boxes. 250 are shipped out on Monday, and twice that amount are shipped out on Tuesday. How many boxes remain?
question_konkani: एका गोदामांत 1000 पेटी आसतात. २५० सोमारा भायर धाडटात, आनी ताचे दुप्पट रक्कम मंगळारा भायर धाडटात. कितले पेटी उरल्यात?
reasoning_english: Tuesday shipment is 250 * 2 = 500 boxes. Total shipped is 250 + 500 = 750. Remaining is 1000 - 750 = 250 boxes.

question_english: Maria runs 3 km on Monday, 5 km on Wednesday, and twice as much on Friday as she did on Monday. What is her total distance for the week?
question_konkani: मारिया सोमारा 3 किमी, बिरेस्तारा 5 किमी आनी शुक्रारा सोमारा परस दुप्पट धांवता. सप्तका खातीर तिचें वट्ट अंतर कितलें?
reasoning_english: Friday distance is 2 * 3 = 6 km. Total distance is 3 + 5 + 6 = 14 km.

question_english: A shopkeeper has 12 boxes of chocolates, each containing 20 pieces. He repacks them into smaller boxes of 8 pieces each. How many smaller boxes does he fill?
question_konkani: एका दुकानदाराक चॉकलेटींच्यो १२ पेटी आसतात, दरेक पेटी २० कुडके आसतात. तो तांकां परतून पॅक करून दरेकीं 8 कुडके आशिल्ल्या ल्हान पेटींत घालता. कितले ल्हान ल्हान पेटी तो भरता?
reasoning_english: Total chocolates is 12 * 20 = 240. Number of smaller boxes is 240 / 8 = 30.

question_english: David has ₹1000. He buys a shirt for ₹450 and shoes for ₹300. He then earns ₹200 doing chores. How much money does he have now?
question_konkani: डेव्हिडा कडेन ₹1000 आसात. तो ₹450 च्या मोलान शर्ट आनी ₹300 च्या मोलान पांयतणां घेता. उपरांत तो घरांतलीं कामां करून ₹200 मेळयता. आतां ताचे कडेन कितले पयशे आसात?
reasoning_english: David spends 450 + 300 = ₹750, leaving him with 1000 - 750 = ₹250. He earns ₹200, making it 250 + 200 = ₹450.

question_english: A library has 5000 books. 200 books are borrowed and 50 are returned. Then, 30 new books are added. How many books are in the library now?
question_konkani: एका वाचनालयांत ५००० पुस्तकां आसात. 200 पुस्तकां रीण घेतात आनी 50 परत दितात. मागीर, 30 नवे पुस्तक जोडटात. आतां लायब्ररींत कितली पुस्तकां आसात?
reasoning_english: Start with 5000. Borrowed: 5000 - 200 = 4800. Returned: 4800 + 50 = 4850. Added: 4850 + 30 = 4880 books.

question_english: A baker makes 60 cupcakes. He sells 2/3 of them in the morning and 5 in the afternoon. How many cupcakes are left?
question_konkani: एक बेकर 60 कपकेक तयार करता. तातूंतले २/३ सकाळीं आनी दनपारां ५ विकता. कितले कपकेक उरल्यात?
reasoning_english: Morning sales: (2/3) * 60 = 40. Remaining is 60 - 40 = 20. Afternoon sales: 20 - 5 = 15 cupcakes left.

question_english: In a game, player A scores 50 points. Player B scores 15 points more than A. Player C scores half of B's points. What is C's score?
question_konkani: खेळांत अ खेळगडो 50 गूण मेळयता. ब खेळगडो अ परस 15 गूण चड गूण मेळयता, क खेळगडो ब च्या अर्दे गूण मेळयता. सी चो गूण कितें?
reasoning_english: Player B scores 50 + 15 = 65 points. Player C scores 65 / 2 = 32.5 points.
reasoning_konkani: ब खेळगडो 50 + 15 = 65 गूण मेळयता. खेळगडो सी 65 / 2 = 32.5 गूण मेळयता.

question_english: A gardener plants 5 rows of rose bushes with 8 bushes in each row. After a week, 3 bushes die. He then plants 10 new bushes. How many bushes are there now?
question_konkani: एक माळी गुलाबाच्या झाडांच्यो ५ वळी लायतात आनी दरेक वळींत ८ झाडां आसतात. सप्तका उपरांत ३ झाडां मरतात. उपरांत तो १० नवी झाडां लायता. आतां कितले झाडां आसात?
reasoning_english: Initial bushes: 5 * 8 = 40. After 3 die: 40 - 3 = 37. After planting 10 new: 37 + 10 = 47 bushes.

question_english: A family orders 4 pizzas. Each pizza has 8 slices. If 5 people eat 3 slices each, how many slices are left?
question_konkani: एक कुटुंब 4 पिझ्झा ऑर्डर करता. दर एका पिझ्झाक ८ कातडी आसतात. 5 जाणांनी दरेकीं 3 कातडी खाल्यार कितले कातडे उरतात?
reasoning_english: Total slices: 4 * 8 = 32. Slices eaten: 5 * 3 = 15. Slices left: 32 - 15 = 17.

question_english: A person walks 2 km North, then 3 km East, then 2 km South. How far are they from their starting point and in which direction?
question_konkani: एक मनीस २ किमी उत्तर, मागीर ३ किमी उदेंत, मागीर २ किमी दक्षिण चलता. ते आपल्या सुरवातीच्या बिंदू पासून कितले पयस आनी खंयचे दिकेन आसात?
reasoning_english: Walking 2 km North and 2 km South cancels out the vertical movement. They only moved 3 km East.
reasoning_konkani: उत्तरेक २ किमी आनी दक्षिणेक २ किमी. ते फकत उदेंतेक ३ किमी.
answer_konkani: ते सुर्वेचे सुवाते सावन 3 किमी उदेंतेक आसात.

question_english: A factory produces 200 toys a day. 5% are defective and thrown away. The rest are packed in boxes of 10. How many boxes are produced in a day?
question_konkani: एका कारखान्यांत दिसाक 200 खेळणीं तयार जातात. ५% दोशी आसून उडयतात. उरिल्लीं 10 जाणांच्या पेटींत पॅक करतात, एका दिसांत कितले पेटी तयार जातात?
reasoning_english: Defective toys: 200 * 0.05 = 10. Good toys: 200 - 10 = 190. Boxes needed: 190 / 10 = 19.

question_english: Anil is 5 years older than Sunil. Sunil is twice as old as Rahul. If Rahul is 10 years old, how old is Anil?
question_konkani: अनिल सुनीला परस 5 वर्सां व्हड. सुनील राहुला परस दुप्पट जाण्टो. राहुल 10 वर्सांचो जाल्यार अनिल कितलो?
reasoning_english: Sunil is 10 * 2 = 20 years old. Anil is 20 + 5 = 25 years old.

question_english: A train has 10 compartments. Each compartment has 40 seats. If 75% of the seats are occupied, how many seats are empty?
question_konkani: एके गाडयेंत 10 विभाग आसतात. दर एका विभागांत 40 आसनां आसतात. 75% आसनां व्यापल्यात जाल्यार कितले आसनां रितीं आसात?
reasoning_english: Total seats: 10 * 40 = 400. Empty seats are 25% of 400, which is 400 * 0.25 = 100.

question_english: A bottle contains 2 liters of juice. Three friends drink 300 ml, 450 ml, and 500 ml respectively. How much juice is left in ml?
question_konkani: एके बाटलेंत २ लिटर रोस आसता. तीन इश्ट अनुक्रमान ३०० मिलिलीटर, ४५० मिलिलीटर आनी ५०० मिलिलीटर पितात. मि.ली.त कितलो रोस उरता?
reasoning_english: 2 liters is 2000 ml. Total drunk is 300 + 450 + 500 = 1250 ml. Remaining is 2000 - 1250 = 750 ml.

question_english: A phone battery is at 100%. Playing a game for 1 hour uses 20%. Watching a video for 1 hour uses 15%. If I play for 2 hours and watch videos for 1 hour, what is the battery percentage?
question_konkani: एक फोन बॅटरी 100% आसा. 1 वरां खेळ खेळ्ळ्यार 20% वापरतात. 1 वरां व्हिडियो पळयल्यार 15% वापरतात. जर हांव 2 वरां खेळटां आनी 1 वरां व्हिडियो पळयतलों जाल्यार बॅटरी टक्केवारी कितली आसतली?
reasoning_english: Gaming uses 2 * 20 = 40%. Video uses 15%. Total used is 40 + 15 = 55%. Battery remaining is 100 - 55 = 45%.

question_english: A fruit seller has 100 oranges. He sells 40 on Monday. On Tuesday, he buys 30 more and sells 50. How many oranges does he have left?
question_konkani: फळां विकपी मनशा कडेन शंबर संत्रां आसतात. सोमारा तो 40 विकता. मंगळारा तो आनीक 30 विकतें घेता आनी 50 विकता, ताचे कडेन कितले संत्रे उरल्यात?
reasoning_english: Monday: 100 - 40 = 60 remaining. Tuesday: 60 + 30 = 90. Then he sells 50, leaving 90 - 50 = 40.

question_english: Ravi is taller than Amit. Amit is taller than Sam. Who is the shortest?
question_konkani: रवी अमितापरस उंच आसा. अमित सॅम परस ऊंच आसा. सगळ्यांत ल्हान कोण?
reasoning_english: Ravi > Amit > Sam. Therefore, Sam is the shortest of the three.
reasoning_konkani: रवि > अमित > सं. देखून सॅम हो तिगांयमदीं सगळ्यांत ल्हान.

question_english: If it is raining, the ground is wet. The ground is not wet. Is it raining?
question_konkani: पावस पडटा जाल्यार जमीन ओली आसता. जमीन ओली ना. पावस पडटा काय?
reasoning_english: By modus tollens, since the ground is not wet, the condition for it raining is not met. Therefore, it is not raining.
reasoning_konkani: मोडस टोलेन्स पद्दतीन जमीन ओली नाशिल्ल्यान ताका पावस पडपाची अट पुराय जायना. देखून पावस पडना.

question_english: All cats have tails. Fluffy is a cat. Does Fluffy have a tail?
question_konkani: सगळ्या माजरांक शेंपडी आसता. फुलपी एक माजर. फ्लफीक शेंपडी आसा काय?
reasoning_english: Fluffy is a cat, and all cats have tails. Therefore, Fluffy must have a tail.
reasoning_konkani: फुलपी माजर आसून सगळ्या माजरांक शेंपडी आसतात. देखून फ्लफीक शेंपडी आसूंक जाय.

question_english: If A is heavier than B, and B is heavier than C, which is the heaviest?
question_konkani: अ ब परस जड आसत जाल्यार आनी ब क परस जड आसल्यार खंयचें सगळ्यांत जड?
reasoning_english: The order of weight from heaviest to lightest is A, B, C. Thus, A is the heaviest.
reasoning_konkani: सगळ्यांत जड ते हलके वजनाचे क्रम अ, ब, क असो आसता.अशे तरेन अ हो सगळ्यांत जड आसता.

question_english: Today is Wednesday. What day will it be 4 days from now?
question_konkani: आयज बिरेस्तार. आतां 4 दिसांनी खंयचो दीस जातलो?
reasoning_english: Counting 4 days forward from Wednesday: Thursday (1), Friday (2), Saturday (3), Sunday (4).
reasoning_konkani: बिरेस्तारा सावन फुडें 4 दीस मेजप: आयतार (1), शुक्रार (2), शेनवार (3), आयतार (4).

question_english: A is the father of B. B is the father of C. How is A related to C?
question_konkani: अ हो ब हाचो बापूय ब हो क हाचो बापूय अ हो क कडेन कसो संबंद आसा?
reasoning_english: Since A is the father of C's father (B), A is the grandfather of C.
reasoning_konkani: अ हो क हाच्या बापायचो (ब) बापूय आशिल्ल्यान अ हो क हाचो आजो.
answer_english: A is the grandfather of C.
answer_konkani: A हो C चो आजो आसा.

question_english: Only students with an ID card can enter the library. John does not have an ID card. Can John enter the library?
question_konkani: फकत आयडी कार्ड आशिल्ल्या विद्यार्थ्यांकच लायब्ररींत प्रवेश मेळटलो. जॉना कडेन आयडी कार्ड ना. जॉन लायब्ररींत भितर सरूंक शकता?
reasoning_english: Entering the library requires an ID card. John lacks one, so he cannot enter.
reasoning_konkani: लायब्ररींत प्रवेश करपाक आयडी कार्ड जाय पडटा. जॉनाक एक उणाव आसा, देखून ताका भितर सरूंक मेळना.

question_english: In a race, you pass the person in 2nd place. What place are you in now?
question_konkani: सर्तींत 2 व्या क्रमांकाचेर आशिल्ल्या मनशाक पास जाता. आतां खंयच्या जाग्यार आसात?
reasoning_english: If you pass the person in 2nd place, you take their position, making you 2nd.
reasoning_konkani: 2 व्या क्रमांकाचेर आशिल्ल्या मनशाक पास केल्यार तांची सुवात घेतात, जाका लागून तुमी 2 व्या क्रमांकाचेर जातात.

question_english: Mary's mother has four daughters: April, May, June, and what is the name of the fourth daughter?
question_konkani: मरीच्या आवयक चार धुवो आसात: एप्रिल, मे, जून आनी चवथ्या चलयेचें नांव कितें?
reasoning_english: The daughters belong to Mary's mother. Three are named April, May, and June. The fourth is Mary herself.
reasoning_konkani: धुवो मरियम्माचे आवयच्यो. तीनांक एप्रिल, मे आनी जून अशीं नांवां आसात. चवथी स्वता मरियम्मा.

question_english: If some blips are blops, and all blops are blangs, are some blips blangs?
question_konkani: कांय ब्लिप ब्लॉप आसत जाल्यार, आनी सगळे ब्लॉप ब्लॅंग आसल्यार कांय ब्लिप ब्लॅंग आसात काय?
reasoning_english: Since some blips are blops, and every blop is a blang, those blips that are blops must also be blangs. So yes.
reasoning_konkani: कांय ब्लिप ब्लॉप आसतात, आनी दरेक ब्लॉप ब्लॅंग आशिल्ल्यान ब्लॉप आशिल्ले ते ब्लॅंगय ब्लॅंग आसूंक जाय. तर होंय.

question_english: Red houses are built of red bricks. Blue houses are built of blue bricks. What is a greenhouse built of?
question_konkani: तांबड्या घरां तांबड्या विटांनी बांदतात. निळ्या रंगाचीं घरां निळ्या विटांनी बांदतात. ग्रीनहाउस कितें बांदतात?
reasoning_english: A greenhouse is a glass building used to grow plants, not a house built of green bricks.
reasoning_konkani: ग्रीनहाउस म्हळ्यार कंवचेची इमारत वनस्पत वाडोवपाखातीर वापरतात, पाचव्या विटांनी बांदिल्लें घर न्हय.
answer_english: A greenhouse is built of glass.

question_english: If you turn a right-handed glove inside out, which hand will it fit?
question_konkani: उजव्या हाताचो मोजा भितरल्यान भायर घुंवडायल्यार तो खंयच्या हाताक बसतलो?
reasoning_english: Turning a right-handed glove inside out reverses its orientation, making it fit the left hand.
reasoning_konkani: उजव्या हाताचो मोजा भितरल्यान भायर घुंवडायल्यार ताची दिका उलटता आनी ताका लागून तो डाव्या हाताक बसता.
answer_english: It will fit the left hand.

question_english: If a box contains only red and blue balls, and I draw one ball that is not red, what color is it?
question_konkani: जर एका पेटींत फकत तांबडे आनी निळे गोल आसतात, आनी हांव तांबडो नाशिल्लो एक गोल काडलो जाल्यार तो खंयचो रंग?
reasoning_english: The only colors available are red and blue. If it is not red, it must be blue.
reasoning_konkani: तांबडो आनी निळो अशे एकूच रंग उपलब्ध आसात. तांबडो नासल्यार तो निळो आसूंक जाय.

question_english: Every time the bell rings, the dog barks. The dog is barking. Did the bell ring?
question_konkani: दर खेपे घंटी वाजता तेन्ना सुणो भोंकारता. सुणो भोंकता. घंटी वाजली काय?
reasoning_english: The bell ringing causes barking, but other things could also cause barking. We cannot be certain the bell rang.
reasoning_konkani: घंटी वाजल्यार भोंकार येता, पूण हेर गजालींनी भोंवतणूय जावंक शकता. घंटी वाजली हाची खात्री करपाक मेळना.

question_english: If X is an even number, is X + 1 odd or even?
question_konkani: X हो सम संख्या आसल्यार X + 1 विषम वा सम?
reasoning_english: Adding 1 to any even number always results in an odd number.
reasoning_konkani: खंयच्याय सम संख्यांत 1 जोडल्यार सदांच विषम संख्या मेळटा.

question_english: Box A is larger than Box B. Box C is smaller than Box B. Which box is the largest?
question_konkani: पेटी अ बॉक्स ब परस व्हडली बॉक्स क बॉक्स ब परस ल्हान खंयची पेटी सगळ्यांत व्हडली?
reasoning_english: A is larger than B, and B is larger than C (since C is smaller). So A is the largest.
reasoning_konkani: अ हो ब परस व्हडलो आनी ब हो क परस व्हडलो (क ल्हान आशिल्ल्यान). म्हणजे अ हो सगळ्यांत व्हडलो.

question_english: If all squares are rectangles, and all rectangles are polygons, are all squares polygons?
question_konkani: सगळे चौकोन आयत आसत जाल्यार, आनी सगळे आयत बहुभुज आसल्यार सगळे चौकोन बहुभुज आसात?
reasoning_english: By the transitive property of subsets, since squares are a subset of rectangles and rectangles are a subset of polygons, squares are polygons.
reasoning_konkani: उपसमुहांच्या संक्रामक गुणधर्मान वर्ग हो आयतांचो उपसमुह आनी आयत हो बहुभुजांचो उपसमुह आशिल्ल्यान वर्ग हे बहुभुज आसतात.

question_english: The key is in either the red drawer or the blue drawer. It is not in the blue drawer. Where is it?
question_konkani: चावी तांबड्या ड्रॉअरांत वा निळ्या ड्रॉअरांत आसता. तो निळ्या ड्रॉअरांत ना. खंय आसा?
reasoning_english: By process of elimination, if it must be in one of the two and is not in the blue drawer, it is in the red drawer.
reasoning_konkani: काडून उडोवपाचे प्रक्रियेन तो दोगांय मदल्या एका ड्रॉअरांत आसूंक जाय आनी निळ्या ड्रॉअरांत ना जाल्यार तो तांबड्या ड्रॉअरांत आसता.
answer_english: It is in the red drawer.

question_english: If 5 is greater than 3, and 3 is greater than X, can X be 6?
question_konkani: ५ जर ३ परस व्हड आसत जाल्यार, आनी ३ X परस व्हड आसल्यार X ६ जावंक शकता?
reasoning_english: If 3 is greater than X, then X must be less than 3. Since 6 is not less than 3, X cannot be 6.
reasoning_konkani: जर 3 X परस व्हड आसत जाल्यार X 3 परस उणो आसूंक जाय.6 3 परस उणो नाशिल्ल्यान X 6 आसूंक शकना.

question_english: A is equal to B. B is equal to C. Is A equal to C?
question_konkani: अ हो ब इतलो ब हो क इतलो अ हो क इतलो आसा?
reasoning_english: By the transitive property of equality, if A = B and B = C, then A = C.
reasoning_konkani: समतेच्या संक्रामक गुणधर्मान अ = ब आनी ब = क जाल्यार अ = क.
answer_english: Yes, A is equal to C.
answer_konkani: हय, A हो C च्या बरोबरीचो आसा.

question_english: Rahul left his umbrella at home and it started raining heavily. What problem is he likely to face?
question_konkani: राहुलान आपली छत्री घरांत सोडली आनी व्हड पावस पडपाक लागलो. ताका खंयचो प्रस्न पडपाची शक्यताय आसा?
reasoning_english: Without an umbrella in heavy rain, Rahul has no protection from the water.
reasoning_konkani: व्हड पावसांत छत्री नासतना राहुलाक उदका कडल्यान कसलीच राखण ना.

question_english: You drop a glass cup on a hard concrete floor. What is most likely to happen to the cup?
question_konkani: तुमी कंवचेचो कप कठीण काँक्रीटाच्या माळयेर सोडटात. पेलाक कितें जावपाची चड शक्यताय आसा?
reasoning_english: Glass is fragile and concrete is very hard. The impact will cause the glass to break.
reasoning_konkani: कंवची नाजूक आसून काँक्रीट खूब कठीण आसता. ह्या आघाताक लागून कंवची मोडटली.

question_english: It is 2 AM and John is feeling very tired. What should he do?
question_konkani: सकाळीं 2 जाल्यात आनी जॉनाक खूब थकवा येता. ताणें कितें करचें?
reasoning_english: When someone is tired late at night, the natural and healthy response is to sleep.
reasoning_konkani: रातच्या वेळार कोणूय थकता तेन्ना सैमीक आनी भलायकेक बरो प्रतिसाद म्हळ्यार न्हीद.

question_english: A plant has not been watered for a month in hot weather. What will happen to it?
question_konkani: उश्ण हवामानांत म्हयनोभर झाडाक उदक दिवंक ना. ताचें कितें जातलें?
reasoning_english: Plants need water to survive, especially in hot weather. Without it for a month, it will die.
reasoning_konkani: वनस्पत जियेवपाखातीर खास करून उश्ण हवामानांत उदकाची गरज आसता. एक म्हयनो ताचेबगर तो मरतलो.

question_english: You add sugar to a cup of hot tea and stir it. What happens to the sugar?
question_konkani: तुमी एक कप गरम च्यांत साकर घालून ती हालयतात. साकर कितें जाता?
reasoning_english: Sugar is soluble in water, and heat speeds up the process. Stirring will make it dissolve.
reasoning_konkani: साकर उदकांत विरगळटा आनी उश्णतायेक लागून ही प्रक्रिया बेगीन जाता. हालयल्यार तो विरगळटा.

question_english: Priya touches a hot stove with her bare hand. What will she feel?
question_konkani: प्रिया आपल्या उक्त्या हातान गरम चुलीक हात लायता. तिका कितें दिसतलें?
reasoning_english: A hot stove transfers intense heat to the skin, causing pain and a burn.
reasoning_konkani: गरम चुली कातींत खर उश्णताय हस्तांतरीत करता आनी ताका लागून दुखप आनी जळप जाता.

question_english: The electricity goes out at night while you are reading. What happens to the room?
question_konkani: तुमी वाचतना रातच्या वेळार वीज बंद जाता. कुडीचें कितें जाता?
reasoning_english: Without electricity, the lights will turn off, and at night, there is no natural sunlight.
reasoning_konkani: वीज नासतना लायटी बंद जातली आनी रातच्या वेळार सैमीक सुर्याचो उजवाड ना.

question_english: A person puts a bottle of water in the freezer and leaves it overnight. What happens to the water?
question_konkani: मनीस फ्रीझरांत उदकाची बाटली घालून रातभर सोडटा. उदकाचें कितें जाता?
reasoning_english: The freezer is below 0°C. Water freezes into ice at this temperature.
reasoning_konkani: फ्रीझर ० सॅ. ह्या तापमानांत उदक गोठून बर्फ जाता.
answer_english: The water will freeze into ice.

question_english: You leave a chocolate bar in the hot sun for 2 hours. What will happen to it?
question_konkani: तुमी एक चॉकलेट बार 2 वरां गरम सुर्याक सोडटात. ताचें कितें जातलें?
reasoning_english: Chocolate has a low melting point. The heat from the sun will cause it to melt.
reasoning_konkani: चॉकलेटीचो वितळबिंदू उणो आसता. सुर्याक येवपी उश्णतायेक लागून तो वितळटलो.

question_english: Someone forgets to lock their car and leaves an expensive phone on the seat. What is a possible risk?
question_konkani: कोण तरी आपली गाडी लॉक करपाक विसरता आनी सीटाचेर म्हत्वाचो फोन सोडटा. संभाव्य धोको कितें?
reasoning_english: An unlocked car with valuables visible is an easy target for theft.
reasoning_konkani: मोलादीक वस्तू दिसपी अनलॉक केल्ली गाडी ही चोरीचें सोंपें लक्ष्य.

question_english: A balloon is filled with too much air. What is likely to happen?
question_konkani: एक बलुनो चड हवेन भरिल्लो आसता. कितें जावपाची शक्यताय आसा?
reasoning_english: The pressure inside the balloon exceeds the strength of the rubber, causing it to pop.
reasoning_konkani: बलुनाचो भितरलो दाब रबराच्या बळग्यापरस चड आसता आनी ताका लागून तो पोप जाता.

question_english: You step in a deep puddle wearing socks. How will your feet feel?
question_konkani: मोजे घालून खोल पोंदाक पावल घालता. तुमच्या पांयांक कशें दिसतलें?
reasoning_english: Socks absorb water easily. The puddle will soak the socks and make your feet wet.
reasoning_konkani: मोजां उदक सहज शोशून घेतात. पोंदा मोजां भिजोवन पांय ओले करतलो.

question_english: It is snowing outside and the temperature is below freezing. What should you wear before going out?
question_konkani: भायर बर्फ पडटा आनी तापमान गोठणाच्या सकयल आसा. भायर वचचे पयलीं कितें घालचें?
reasoning_english: Snow and freezing temperatures require clothing that retains body heat.
reasoning_konkani: बर्फ आनी गोठण तापमानांत कुडीची उश्णताय तिगोवन दवरपी कपडे जाय पडटात.

question_english: A dog hasn't eaten all day and sees a piece of meat on the floor. What will the dog likely do?
question_konkani: एक सुणो दीसभर जेवंक ना आनी ताका जमनीर मांसाचो कुडको दिसता. सुणो कितें करतलो अशी शक्यताय आसा?
reasoning_english: A hungry dog will instinctively eat available food, especially meat.
reasoning_konkani: उपाशी सुणो सहजपणान उपलब्ध आशिल्लें अन्न, खास करून मांस खातलो.
answer_english: The dog will eat the meat.

question_english: The traffic light turns red. What should the cars do?
question_konkani: ट्रॅफिक लायट तांबडो जाता. गाडयांनी कितें करचें?
reasoning_english: A red traffic light is a universal signal for vehicles to stop.
reasoning_konkani: तांबडो ट्रॅफिक लायट हो वाहनांक थांबपाचो एक सार्वत्रिक संकेत.

question_english: A is left of B. C is right of B. Which object is in the middle?
question_konkani: A हो B च्या उजव्या C. B च्या उजव्यान खंयची वस्तू मदीं आसा?
reasoning_english: The order is A, then B, then C. B is between A and C.
reasoning_konkani: क्रम अ, मागीर ब, मागीर क.ब हो अ आनी क हांचेमदीं आसता.

question_english: The book is on the table and the phone is beside the book. Where is the phone relative to the table?
question_konkani: पुस्तक मेजाचेर आनी फोन पुस्तका कुशीक आसा. मेजाच्या सापेक्ष फोन खंय आसा?
reasoning_english: Since the phone is next to the book, and the book is resting on the table, the phone must also be on the table.
reasoning_konkani: फोन पुस्तका कुशीक आशिल्ल्यान, आनी पुस्तक मेजाचेर आराम करता देखून फोनय मेजाचेर आसूंक जाय.
answer_english: The phone is on the table.

question_english: A cat is sitting under a chair. A dog is sitting on the chair. Who is higher up?
question_konkani: एक माजर कुर्सी सकयल बसल्या. एक सुणो कुर्सीचेर बसला. कोण चड वयर आसा?
reasoning_english: The seat of the chair is higher than the space underneath it. Since the dog is on the chair, the dog is higher.
reasoning_konkani: ताचे सकयल आशिल्ल्या जाग्यापरस खुर्ची बसपाची सुवात चड आसता. सुणो खुर्चेर आशिल्ल्यान सुणो चड ऊंच आसता.

question_english: Town A is north of Town B. Town C is south of Town B. Which town is the furthest north?
question_konkani: अ शार ब शाराचे उत्तरेक आसा, क शार ब शाराचे दक्षिणेक आसा, खंयचें शार उत्तरेक सगळ्यांत पयस आसा?
reasoning_english: The order from north to south is A, B, C. Thus, Town A is the furthest north.
reasoning_konkani: उत्तरेकडल्यान दक्षिणेकडलो क्रम अ, ब, क असो आसा.अशे तरेन अ शार उत्तरेक सगळ्यांत पयस आसा.
answer_english: Town A is the furthest north.

question_english: A picture hangs on the wall above the fireplace. Where is the fireplace relative to the picture?
question_konkani: अग्नीकुंडाच्या वयर वण्टीचेर एक चित्र लटकलां. चित्राच्या सापेक्ष उजो खंय आसा?
reasoning_english: If the picture is above the fireplace, then the fireplace must be below the picture.
reasoning_konkani: चित्र उज्याच्या वयर आसल्यार मागीर उज्यागार चित्रा सकयल आसूंक जाय.
answer_english: The fireplace is below the picture.

question_english: You are facing North. You turn 90 degrees to your right. Which direction are you facing now?
question_konkani: तुमी उत्तरेकडेन तोंड करून आसात. तुमी 90 अंश तुमच्या उजवे वटेन घुंवतात. आतां खंयचे दिकेन तोंड दितात?
reasoning_english: Right of North on a compass is East.
reasoning_konkani: होकायंत्राचेर उत्तरेचो उजवो उदेंत आसता.
answer_konkani: तुमी आतां उदेंतेक तोंड करून आसात.

question_english: If point X is halfway between Y and Z, and Y is at 0 cm while Z is at 10 cm, where is X?
question_konkani: X बिंदू Y आनी Z हांचेमदीं अर्दवट आसल्यार, आनी Y 0 सेंमी. जाल्यार Z 10 सेंमी.चेर आसल्यार X खंय आसा?
reasoning_english: Halfway between 0 and 10 is calculated as (0 + 10) / 2 = 5.
reasoning_konkani: ० आनी १० हांचेमदल्या अर्द्या वाटेर (० + १०) / २ = ५ अशें मेजतात.

question_english: A cube is placed on top of a cylinder. Which object touches the ground?
question_konkani: सिलिंडराचेर एक घन दवरतात. खंयची वस्तू जमनीक स्पर्श करता?
reasoning_english: Since the cube is on top, the cylinder is underneath it and touching the ground.
reasoning_konkani: घन वयर आशिल्ल्यान सिलेंडर ताचे सकयल आसता आनी जमनीक स्पर्श करता.

question_english: The TV is in front of the sofa. The window is behind the sofa. If you sit on the sofa facing the TV, where is the window?
question_konkani: टीव्ही सोफा मुखार आसा. जनेलां सोफा फाटल्यान आसा. टीव्ही कडेन तोंड करून सोफाचेर बसल्यार जनेलां खंय आसात?
reasoning_english: You are on the sofa facing front (towards TV). The window is behind the sofa, so it is behind you.
reasoning_konkani: तुमी फुडें (टीव्ही कडेन) तोंड करून सोफाचेर आसात. जनेलां सोफा फाटल्यान आसता, देखून ती तुमच्या फाटल्यान आसता.

question_english: Car A is parked next to Car B. Car C is parked on the other side of Car B. Which car is between the other two?
question_konkani: गाडी अ गाडी ब कुशीक उबी आसा गाडी क ब गाडयेचे दुसरे वटेन उबी आसा हेर दोगां मदीं खंयची गाडी आसा?
reasoning_english: Car B has Car A on one side and Car C on the other side, making it the middle car.
reasoning_konkani: ब गाडी एके वटेन अ गाडी आनी दुसरे वटेन क गाडी आशिल्ल्यान ती मदली गाडी थारता.
answer_english: Car B is between the other two.
answer_konkani: गाडी B हेर दोन गाड्यांच्या मदीं आसा.

question_english: What is the next number in the sequence: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
reasoning_english: Each number is multiplied by 2 to get the next. 16 * 2 = 32.
reasoning_konkani: दरेक आंकडो 2 गुणाकार करून फुडलो मेळटा. १६ * २ = ३२ हें नांव.

question_english: Find the next element in the sequence: A, C, E, G, ?
question_konkani: क्रमांतलें फुडलें घटक सोदून काडात: A, C, E, G, ?
reasoning_english: The sequence skips one letter each time (B, D, F, H are skipped). The letter after G, skipping H, is I.
reasoning_konkani: क्रम दर खेपे एक अक्षर वगडायता (ब, ड, फ, ह वगडायतात). एच वगडावन जी उपरांतचें अक्षर I.

question_english: What is the next number in the sequence: 10, 9, 7, 4, ?
reasoning_english: The differences between numbers are -1, -2, -3. The next difference should be -4. 4 - 4 = 0.
reasoning_konkani: संख्यांमदले फरक -१, -२, -३ अशे आसात. फुडलो फरक -4 आसूंक जाय. ४ - ४ = ० अशें आसता.

question_english: A triangle has 3 sides, a square has 4, and a pentagon has 5. How many sides does a hexagon have?
question_konkani: त्रिकोणाक ३ बाजू, चौकोनाक ४ आनी पंचकोनाक ५.षटकोनाक कितले बाजू आसतात?
reasoning_english: By definition, a hexagon is a polygon with 6 sides.
reasoning_konkani: व्याख्येप्रमाण षटकोन म्हळ्यार ६ बाजू आशिल्लो बहुभुज.

question_english: Up, Down, Left, Right, Up, Down, Left, ? What comes next?
question_konkani: वयर, सकयल, डावें, उजवें, वयर, सकयल, डावें, ? फुडें कितें येता?
reasoning_english: The pattern 'Up, Down, Left, Right' repeats. After 'Left' comes 'Right'.
reasoning_konkani: ‘वयर, सकयल, डावें, उजवें’ हो नमुनो परत परत येता. ‘डावें’ उपरांत ‘उजवें’ येता.

question_english: What follows in the pattern: Red, Blue, Red, Blue, Red, ?
question_konkani: नमुन्यांत कितें दिसता: तांबडो, निळो, तांबडो, निळो, तांबडो, ?
reasoning_english: The pattern alternates between Red and Blue. After Red, it must be Blue.
reasoning_konkani: नमुनो तांबडो आनी निळो हांचेमदीं पर्यायीपणान आसता. तांबड्या उपरांत तो निळो आसूंक जाय.

question_english: What is the next number: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
reasoning_english: These are the squares of integers: 1^2, 2^2, 3^2, 4^2, 5^2. The next is 6^2 = 36.

question_english: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, ? What day comes next?
question_konkani: आयतार, सोमार, मंगळार, बुधवार, ? फुडें खंयचो दीस येता?
reasoning_english: This is the standard sequence of days in a week. The day after Wednesday is Thursday.
reasoning_konkani: सप्तकांतल्या दिसांचो हो प्रमाण क्रम. बुधवारा उपरांतचो दीस आयतार आसता.

question_english: Circle is to Sphere as Square is to ?
question_konkani: वर्तुळ गोलाक आसता तशें चौकोन हें ?
reasoning_english: A sphere is the 3D equivalent of a 2D circle. The 3D equivalent of a square is a cube.
reasoning_konkani: गोल म्हळ्यार 2D वर्तुळाचो 3D समतुल्य. चौकोनाचें 3D समतुल्य घन आसता.

question_english: What comes next: a1, b2, c3, d4, ?
reasoning_english: The pattern pairs consecutive letters of the alphabet with consecutive numbers. After 'd' comes 'e' and after 4 comes 5.
reasoning_konkani: नमुन्यांत वर्णमाळेंतल्या सलग अक्षरांची जोडी सलग आंकड्यांवांगडा करतात. 'ड' उपरांत 'ई' आनी 4 उपरांत 5 येता.

question_english: A person needs to reach a place before 9 AM. Bus A takes 40 minutes and arrives at 8:30. Bus B takes 20 minutes but arrives at 9:15. Which bus should they choose?
question_konkani: मनशाक सकाळीं 9 वरां पयलीं एका सुवातेर पावपाची गरज आसता. बस अ 40 मिनटां लागता आनी 8:30 वरांचेर पावता. बस बी 20 मिनटां लागता पूण 9:15 वरांचेर पावता. तांणी खंयची बस निवडची?
reasoning_english: Bus B arrives after the 9 AM deadline. Bus A arrives at 8:30, which is before 9 AM.
reasoning_konkani: सकाळीं 9 वरांचे मुजती उपरांत बस बी पावता. बस अ सकाळीं 8:30 वरांचेर पावता, ती सकाळीं 9 वरां पयलीं.

question_english: You have ₹100. Item X costs ₹60 and Item Y costs ₹50. Can you buy both?
question_konkani: तुमचे कडेन ₹100 आसात. आयटम एक्स ₹60 आनी आयटम वाय ₹50. दोनूय विकतें घेवंक मेळटात?
reasoning_english: The total cost of both items is 60 + 50 = ₹110. You only have ₹100, which is not enough.
reasoning_konkani: दोनूय वस्तूंचो वट्ट खर्च 60 + 50 = ₹110 आसा. तुमचे कडेन फकत ₹100 आसात, जें पुरो जायना.
answer_konkani: ना, तुमी दोनी वस्तू घेवंक शकनात.

question_english: It is raining and you want to stay dry on your walk. You have a choice between a hat and an umbrella. Which should you choose?
question_konkani: पावस पडटा आनी भोंवतना सुकी रावपाची इत्सा आसा. टोपी आनी छत्री हांचे मदीं तुमकां पर्याय आसा. खंयचें वेंचून काडचें?
reasoning_english: An umbrella covers the whole body and is designed specifically to keep you dry in the rain, whereas a hat only covers the head.
reasoning_konkani: छत्री पुराय आंग व्यापून दवरता आनी पावसांत सुकी दवरपा खातीर खासा तयार केल्ली आसता, जाल्यार टोपी फकत तकली व्यापता.

question_english: A doctor prescribes a medicine to be taken every 8 hours. If the first dose is taken at 8 AM, when should the second dose be taken?
question_konkani: एक दोतोर दर 8 वरांनी घेवपाचें वखद सांगता. पयलो डोस सकाळीं 8 वरांचेर घेतल्यार दुसरो डोस केन्ना घेवचो?
reasoning_english: Adding 8 hours to 8 AM results in 4 PM.
reasoning_konkani: सकाळीं 8 वरांचेर 8 वरां जोडल्यार सांजवेळा 4 वरांचेर जाता.
answer_english: The second dose should be taken at 4 PM.
answer_konkani: दुसरो डोस 4 PM च्या वेळार घेवंक जाय.

question_english: Your phone battery is at 5% and you have an important call in 10 minutes. Should you play a heavy mobile game or plug in the charger?
question_konkani: तुमचो फोन बॅटरी 5% आसा आनी तुमकां 10 मिनटांनी म्हत्वाचो कॉल येता. मोबायलाचो जड खेळ खेळचो काय चार्जर प्लग करचो?
reasoning_english: Playing a heavy game will drain the remaining 5% quickly. Plugging in the charger will ensure the phone stays on for the call.
reasoning_konkani: जड खेळ खेळ्ळ्यार उरिल्ले 5% बेगीन निवळ जातले. चार्जर प्लग केल्यार कॉला खातीर फोन चालू उरतलो हाची खात्री जातली.
answer_english: You should plug in the charger.
